criteria.text: Every consumed package preserves its declared authority direction while exposing one validated current XML representation; PDF manifest, provenance, uncertainty, authored-Markdown round trip, dependency, asset, and computed conversion-coverage checks pass without claiming machine-proved PDF fidelity.
Stable item identities, hierarchy, order, exact content, typed metadata, provenance, semantic digests, dependencies, and mechanical DOM locators are preserved end to end.
Every navigator relation has one owner and exact directional digest-bound endpoints; forward and reverse links resolve with no duplicate, stale, inferred, ambiguous, or silently retargeted assertion.
Controlled semantic wording resolves only from current wording XML with exact contexts and typed slots, while ordinary interface copy remains template or code owned.

All production semantic reads use one secure read-only XML gateway; undeclared inputs, external resources, path escapes, unsupported formats, aliases, fallbacks, and writes to semantic authorities fail.
The gateway seals one immutable typed model; renderers consume only its typed API and cannot persist, infer, repair, normalize, or independently parse semantic content.
The exact current NA and AF claim versions, claim and unit census, groups, dependencies, strategy prefixes, artifact names, and edition isolation rules hold.

Every selectable fragment has exactly mapped or counsel-review-required state; candidate targets, cautions, gates, dispositions, phrase rules, and honest no-candidate behavior are complete and internally consistent.
Every dynamic value is escaped for its declared output context; hostile markup, script, URL, style, event-handler, and raw-template inputs remain inert.

Forward/reverse relation data, target order, cycling and highlight bounds, badges, clearing and focus-return instructions, and the complete printable schedule derive from the same relation set and are present in the artifact.
Static HTML exposes semantic non-nested controls, logical order, scoped keyboard instructions, accessible names and states, a live region, non-color indicators, and reduced-motion rules.
The artifact contains claims, disclosure, exact label, disclaimer, legend, provenance, and the complete schedule plus print rules for repetition, clipping, and overflow safeguards.
The artifact contains the exact two-pane grid, independent-scroll, fixed-scroll-owner, 1280 by 720 minimum, and below-minimum stacking CSS rules.
Claims, disclosure, exact label, disclaimer, legend, provenance, and the complete mapping schedule exist outside scripts in readable document order.
The exact CSP, self-contained local-file design, forbidden-capability checks, no-network, no-cookie, no-storage, no-telemetry, and secure XML parsing requirements pass.
Fresh derivations are byte-identical; the current candidate equals regenerated bytes; release seals those exact bytes and emits the exact detached checksum by atomic generated-only writes.

The exact current product label, standing disclaimer, confidentiality legend, provenance, internal-anchor caution, and strategy-neutral wording are present in ordinary HTML and the print/no-script surfaces.

Computed coverage and substantive-origin tracing are complete and non-stored; the operative tree contains one XML ingestion path, one typed model, current controls and products, with Git as sole history.

The exact twenty-criterion registry is current, every discovered test runs in an isolated snapshot, document and source-manifest checks pass, and only an unchanged final repository snapshot is certified.

The deterministic STORE ZIP contains exactly both sealed HTML files, their exact detached checksums, and MANIFEST.txt; the manifest contains the exact product label, neutral two-edition wording, and checksums for the four non-manifest members, and the ZIP has its own detached checksum.
